data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this well-maintained 1-bedroom apartment in Hamilton Tower, Business Bay. Offering a spacious layout, bright interiors, and beautiful Canal views, this home is ideal for those seeking comfort, convenience, and a prime location in the heart of Dubai.

Featuring a practical floor plan and a private balcony overlooking the Canal, the apartment provides a welcoming living environment with easy access to the city's major business and leisure destinations.

Property Features:

⦁ 1 Bedroom
⦁ 2 Bathrooms
⦁ Vacant and ready to move in
⦁ Spacious living and dining area
⦁ Private balcony with Canal views
⦁ Well-appointed kitchen
⦁ Low-floor unit
⦁ 1 Covered Parking Space

Building Amenities:

⦁ Swimming Pool
⦁ Fully Equipped Gymnasium
⦁ 24-Hour Security
⦁ Covered Parking
⦁ Walking Distance to Dubai Canal
⦁ Convenient Access to Metro and Major Roads

About Hamilton Tower

Hamilton Tower is a popular residential development in Business Bay, offering residents a vibrant urban lifestyle within one of Dubai's most prestigious business and residential districts. The tower enjoys a strategic location close to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Sheikh Zayed Road, and an array of dining, retail, and entertainment destinations.

Business Bay is renowned for its waterfront setting, modern infrastructure, and excellent connectivity, making it a preferred destination for professionals and families looking to enjoy city living at its finest.
